# Independently authored image appearance controls

`authored/` contains minimal OOXML controls generated by
`tool/fidelity/image_appearance_cases.py`, independently of the Dart parser
and writer. The 80×40 RGB PNG has four solid color quadrants and no external
resources. The case documents cover an inline flip, floating flips,
quarter turns, a negative margin-relative offset, and an explicit outline
and shadow.

`binary/` contains native DOC exports made by LibreOfficeDev
26.8.0.0.alpha0 (`2c87e51eeaa2b413ff4ae097b2705eea1995d8e5`). These are
LibreOffice-produced controls, not Word-authored files. The native bridge
can change interpretation; its loss is measured separately from parser
conversion.

`manifest.json` pins every retained input. The full native receipt is
`doc/evidence/image-appearance-native.json`, and the verified subset and
remaining differences are explained in `doc/image-appearance.md`.

The authoring and measurement programs, fixtures and generated PNG were
created for this repository and are provided under its MPL2.0 license.
